evidence.description: Exact annotated release-candidate tag, resolved commit, application baseline, and successful CI result
Production-tagged release bundle, component digest manifest, deployment log, and exact deployed revision
SPDX SBOM and signature/provenance attestation for the release bundle digest
Route, web-asset, and migration manifests proving the profile and migration ceiling
Isolated staging host, database, Redis, storage, secrets, filesystem, and service identity
Runtime environment, connector mode, profile route set, and absence of out-of-profile routes
Sanitized production-like backup restore and integrity checks before migration
Migrations through 000124, absence of 000125, final schema checksum, and applied versions
Disposable-clone 000124 down/up rehearsal and recovery output
Pre-deploy backup checksum, clean-database restore, and integrity/application connectivity
Health endpoint, web/worker service status, logs, and deployed digest verification
Secure cookies, CSRF/session controls, TLS boundary, and staging-only secret checks
Queue delivery/retry/dead-letter convergence, durable audit events, and alert delivery
Application rollback to a verified artifact, health confirmation, and candidate restoration
At least 60-minute observation metrics, incident log, and operator handoff
AR/AP invoice, payment/allocation, ledger, reconciliation, retry, and audit journey
Sales order, fulfillment, delivery, inventory/accounting effect, retry, and audit journey
Inventory movement, stock-take, costing, duplicate protection, and audit journey
Document version, ACL/review, signature/retention, persistence, and audit journey
Asset, work order, preventive maintenance, meter, spare usage, completion, retry, and audit journey
Two-company and branch-scoped test identities with the baseline access matrix
Direct URL, company/branch switch, and tampered form-payload denial tests
Expired assignment and access-review revocation with an existing session
Forged/retried worker inputs and no-access behavior without cross-scope effects
Signed go/no-go decision, reviewer identities, and matrix-promotion authorization

Application, worker, migrations, and web assets resolve to the recorded candidate digest and commit
